meta.name: guidance-retrieval-eval
meta.description: Locked decision corpus for task-to-decision guidance retrieval evaluation

decisions.rationale: Local single-file persistence keeps deployment and recovery simple.

decisions.decision: Authentication state uses signed HTTP-only cookies
decisions.rationale: The service does not expose bearer credentials to browser JavaScript.

decisions.decision: Public API payloads use JSON serialization
decisions.rationale: JSON is interoperable and inspectable by clients.

decisions.decision: Email delivery remains synchronous in the first release
decisions.rationale: A background worker would add operational infrastructure before demand is proven.

decisions.decision: Request handling emits structured JSON logs
decisions.rationale: Stable fields make production events searchable without parsing prose.

decisions.decision: Python unit tests use pytest fixtures
decisions.rationale: The existing test harness and contributor workflow are pytest based.
Prefer the standard library unless a package provides measured product value.

decisions.decision: Use only the supported installation command
decisions.rationale: Package onboarding must not recommend retired tooling.

decisions.decision: Inject relevant decisions as prompt-time architectural guidance
decisions.rationale: Task context should shape code generation before the independent edit gate evaluates proposed content.

decisions.decision: External directory copy uses approved product language
decisions.rationale: Claude Code task context before code generation may describe architectural constraints that guide the first proposed implementation, but external copy must remain stable.

decisions.decision: Documentation pages follow the approved taxonomy
decisions.rationale: The documentation explains how Claude Code task context before code generation carries architectural constraints into the first proposed implementation.

decisions.decision: Release notes describe shipped behavior only
decisions.rationale: When Claude Code receives task context before code generation, architectural constraints can guide the first proposed implementation; release claims still require evidence.
